items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: And then I worked in 52nd Street with Tiny Grimes had a little band. And then I played with Tiny about six months in the club there.

ctx.x: In Lips' band? I don't remember. I really don't remember but he had a good band. Sandy was on that band. It was a good little band he had. And then I worked in 52nd Street with Tiny Grimes had a little band. And

then I played with Tiny about six months in the club there. And Billie Holiday was singing in the club. We backed her, in fact. And the other act in there was Art Tatum. That's -- those were the two acts in that club. That was also the Yacht Club on 52nd, Club. It was right across the street from the Onyx Club. Yeah.
